eligibility_protocol.rule: Every single item of the 36 retrieved Crossref records is classified into IN_SCOPE, OUT_OF_SCOPE, or INSUFFICIENT_METADATA_TO_CLASSIFY based on verified title and domain
eligibility_protocol.in_scope_criterion: Empirical cycling/aging/degradation dataset of rechargeable lithium-ion cells or packs
eligibility_protocol.out_of_scope_criterion: Non-lithium chemistry, non-cycling datasets (LCA, recycling, surveys, computation), or non-battery domains

deterministic_selection_algorithm.ranking: ascending lexicographical by selection_score over IN_SCOPE entries
deterministic_selection_algorithm.selection: Top-ranked entry in candidates TSV (10.1038/s41597-025-05725-y) becomes CONFIRMATORY_HIGH_DOC_CONTROL upon freeze ratification

blindness_invariant: Dataset repository contents, time-series data files, and README assets of the selected DOI remain strictly unopened prior to execution.
